a:r.a:t: Coimbatore has thousands of street and shelter dogs waiting for homes — but the path from “I want to adopt” to a dog in your home is broken.
Rescue information is scattered across individual shelters, WhatsApp groups and phone calls. Adoption is paperwork-heavy, opaque, and offline.
One trusted, local hub where adopters, fosters and volunteers meet verified Coimbatore shelters — and every step is tracked.
No single place to browse dogs across local shelters with real filters.
Paper forms, no status, no idea where an adoption application stands.
Fostering and volunteering rely on informal, untracked coordination.
